title: A feather comes back
hook: Plumage changes during an animal’s life.

knows: Birds have body structures and interact with their surroundings.
doesNotKnow: The sequence shows an old feather leaving and a replacement growing from the follicle. Molting patterns vary by species and feather type; this simple sequence does not show the entire molt.

misconception: The observed arrangement has a different effect than the one shown.
objective: When a bird molts, what happens to an old feather in the illustrated sequence?

claims.text: Plumage changes during an animal’s life. When a bird molts, what happens to an old feather in the illustrated sequence? The sequence shows an old feather leaving and a replacement growing from the follicle. Molting patterns vary by species and feather type; this simple sequence does not show the entire molt.

claims.text: The stage is a simplified schematic and the scenario is stipulated rather than observed.
After an old flight feather is shed during a normal molt, what can grow from its follicle? A replacement feather can grow after an old feather is shed.
